lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: A semi-regular array of high-luminance circular pixel clusters arranged in approximately five identifiable horizontal rows along the mid-lateral flank, extending from the posterior gill margin toward the caudal peduncle.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Subtle vertical bands of increased pixel intensity intersect the longitudinal rows, creating a grid-like pattern where the highest-intensity nodes are centered at the intersection of the vertical bands and horizontal carinae.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Three distinct longitudinal ridges are visible on the upper half of the flank; the medial ridge exhibits the most pronounced vertical luminance gradient, with high-intensity pixels on the dorsal edge and shadow-cast low-intensity pixels on the ventral edge.

other_distinctive_markers: A distinct high-luminance pixel cluster is present at the distal tip of the lower caudal lobe; a separate high-luminance object is visible immediately inferior to the posterior margin of the pectoral fin.
